acceptance: The projection contract is closed, bounded, provider-neutral, deterministic, and fails closed on malformed/unvalidated input rather than inventing missing semantics.
Data, Roles, Pages, Workflows, and Assumptions projections expose stable semantic identities with deterministic ordering and explicit empty collections.

Assumption rows preserve immutable origin identity and accurately represent inferred/confirmed/corrected/superseded state plus replacement/invalidation-reference summaries without executing any invalidation effect.

Focused tests prove all five view families, empty and mixed inputs, stable projection identity/order, lifecycle variants, provenance preservation, malformed input rejection, and caller-input immutability.

The exact implementation candidate later passes full repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline R2, Alibaba OCR review/accounting where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused deterministic user-view projection tests plus full repository gates.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR accounting/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: The canonical graph and assumption contracts exist, but there is no user-view projection layer. A single bounded read-only projection module can reuse those contracts without adding UI, persistence, or new graph semantics.

requirements: User-view projections are read-only evidence surfaces and never capability, security, billing, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority.
Projection code must not infer or silently synthesize missing Product Graph semantics; malformed or stale input fails closed.
Assumption invalidation references remain inspectable data only and never delete, mutate, cancel, or rerun downstream work.

outcome: A canonical Product Graph revision can be deterministically projected into bounded human-inspectable Data, Roles, Pages, Workflows, and Assumptions view models with stable ordering, provenance-preserving identities, and no mutation or runtime authority.
rationale: SG-000031 and SG-000032 complete the Question Gate and Assumption Ledger parent, unlocking P02-S05. The smallest useful S05 slice is a provider-neutral read-only projection layer over existing canonical graph/assumption state; interactive UI editing and later designer/developer surfaces remain downstream.

risk.recovery: Revert the Product Graph user-view projection module, exports, tests, and evidence. P02-S04 remains closed and IN-P02-S05-T01 returns to not-yet-delivered without affecting graph persistence or semantics.

scope_in: Define a closed ProductGraphUserViewsV1 read-only projection contract for the canonical P02-S05 view families: Data, Roles, Pages, Workflows, and Assumptions.

Project existing validated Product Graph node/edge semantics into stable view items that preserve semantic node identity, kind/status/name/provenance where available, and only the bounded relationship summaries needed for inspection.

Project Assumption Ledger state into inspectable assumption rows with inferred/confirmed/corrected/superseded status, effective statement, immutable origin identity, replacement identity when present, and deterministic invalidation-reference summaries.
Canonicalize every view with deterministic ordering and explicit empty collections so equivalent validated input produces byte-equivalent semantic projection output and a stable projection identity.

Add focused tests covering all five view families, empty/mixed graphs, stable ordering/identity, assumption lifecycle states, malformed or stale inputs, duplicate/reference handling, provenance preservation, and caller-input immutability.
scope_out: No React/UI components, visual styling, browser interaction, editable inspector, graph mutation, source/Git mutation, persistence/database writes, or live provider/model calls.
No capability/security authorization, role enforcement, RLS generation, deployment/publication, billing, credentials, external effects, or automatic invalidation/rerun behavior.
No new Product Graph node/edge semantics, P02-S06 relation vocabulary, P02-S07 dataset semantics, P02-S08 completeness semantics, or P03 context/model routing.
No attempt to infer missing product semantics; projections expose only validated canonical state and explicit assumption state.
title: IN-P02-S05-T01A deterministic Product Graph user-view projections
